comparison.objective: Open breaker clamps, insert a comb busbar, and retighten terminals; candidate removes one retained harness terminal.
comparison.physical_skill: Repeated screwdriver turning plus simultaneous multi-pin insertion versus narrow extraction-tool insertion and pullout.
comparison.success_condition: All pins home, screws clamped, and a 10 N pull test passed versus selected terminal removed while reusable and neighbors retained. Candidate limits are absent.
comparison.reason: Although both involve electrical terminals and tools, this record tests clamp opening, multi-pin installation, and fastening—not depinning.
